reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I only take stuff a doctor tells me to. Nobody has told me I need magnesium, so I'm not adding another one.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? And I have no proof I'm even low on magnesium, so it feels like another waste.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor or a blood test telling me I'm low on magnesium.
